manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
